reason: No live posting redescribes the pain Daniel fixes: the only matched jobs with JD text are Head of Product Marketing and two Strategic Account Executive roles (GTM, not engineering-leadership/platform/cloud-economics pain), and the fresh ATS feed is titles-only ordinary scale hiring (Senior Engineering Manager, Tax Engine Lead, Senior/Staff SWE) at an org that already has the bench. Its own JD already claims production AI agents that 'monitor obligations, populate returns, catch anomalies and assemble audit packs in seconds' - the services-to-AI-product transition Daniel sells is one they have already made.
